resources.string: Configure the data Strato needs before loading your library. The setup uses the same import paths as Settings.
Import your production keys. They are required to decrypt retail game content and to validate firmware.
Firmware is recommended for system applets and other Horizon OS resources. It can be installed after production keys.
Choose the folder that contains your Switch games. More folders can be added later in Settings.
Production keys and at least one game folder are required to finish setup. Firmware is optional.
